content.short: Uniblock provides Web3's first orchestration layer, unifying 1,500+ APIs across 50+ providers.
content.description: Uniblock tackles Web3 development fragmentation by providing unified access to hundreds of blockchain APIs through a single integration. The platform intelligently routes calls to the most suitable provider based on speed, reliability, and cost, and it includes built-in failover protection to maintain continuity. Data is delivered in standardized formats to streamline cross-provider workflows and tooling. Its shared compute unit model means teams pay only for the compute they actually use across all integrated services, enabling scalable, predictable costs.
